name: CSO_FILE_METADATA
description: This table contains the Application level MetaData for files in the IM set of applications.

columns.name: RECORD_ID
columns.description: This is the primary key of the table.

columns.name: DATE_ADDED
columns.description: This is the date that the record was added to the database.

columns.name: DATE_MODIFIED
columns.description: Date record was last modified in database.

columns.name: REPOSITORY_REF_KEY
columns.description: This is the reference key of the Repository.

columns.name: FILENAME
columns.description: File name - without the directory name.

columns.name: FILESIZE
columns.description: Size of the file - 10 digits covers up to 9.3Gb.

columns.name: CHECKSUM
columns.description: This is the Checksum of the uploaded file.

columns.name: BINARY_FILE
columns.description: Flag that determines if the file is binary or text. When not sure treat binary. true - BINARY/BLOB, false - text/CLOB. Column Value 1=BINARY/BLOB , 0=text/CLOB.

columns.name: EXTERNAL_ID
columns.description: Column to keep external file id.

columns.name: OCM_ASSET_ID
columns.description: This column will store the OCM Asset ID after the asset has been successfully migrated to UCM.

columns.name: DISPLAY_FILENAME
columns.description: Display Name of the file. Default will be the FileName.

columns.name: ARTIFACT_TYPE
columns.description: This field will indicate if the file is Attachment (0) or Asset (1).

columns.name: FILE_CONTENT_TYPE
columns.description: File Content Type of the file as returned by File Store.

columns.name: THUMBNAIL_ID
columns.description: ID of the Thumbnail record for this file record.

columns.name: STRIPE_CODE
columns.description: Stripe code this asset is associated with.

columns.name: BU_ORG_IDS_1
columns.description: Business Unit associated with this asset.

columns.name: ASSET_CREATOR
columns.description: User ID of the user creating the asset or thumbnail record (artifact_type 1 or 9).

columns.name: ASSET_MODIFIER
columns.description: User ID of the user modifying the asset or thumbnail record (artifact_type 1 or 9).
